name: paybox-native
description: Capacitor shell for the PayBox PWA — produces installable iOS + Android apps from the same web code.

scripts.sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
scripts.sync:ios: npm run build && npx cap sync ios
scripts.sync:android: npm run build && npx cap sync android
scripts.add:ios: npm run build && npx cap add ios && npm run sync:ios
scripts.add:android: npm run build && npx cap add android && npm run sync:android
scripts.run:ios: npm run sync:ios && npx cap run ios
scripts.run:android: npm run sync:android && npx cap run android
